### What About Him, Lord?
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/what-about-him-lord-one-year-devotions-for-men-june-3.html
Passage: John 21:21-22
Points:
- People naturally struggle with resentment when they suspect unequal treatment or an unfair outcome.
- After learning of his own difficult future, Peter immediately compared himself to John and asked about John's fate.
- Jesus made it clear that what He chooses to do with another disciple is none of Peter's business.
- Believers must not allow comparisons to distract them from Christ's fundamental call to simply follow Him.

### But What About Her?
Author: Stacy J. Lowe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-february-20-2023.html
Passage: John 21:21-22
Points:
- Just as a runner must watch the coach rather than the ball, Christians need to focus on Jesus rather than what others are doing.
- Peter fell into the comparison trap the moment he turned his eyes away from Jesus to look at John.
- Rather than condemning Peter, Jesus lovingly redirected him by asking what John's path had to do with him.
- Measuring our lives against others leads to discouragement, whereas trusting Christ keeps us following His good, individualized plan.
